feature_masks: 88D interface; exact zero after full original patient_z and stored FIT-only imputer/scaler; same mask FIT/VAL/TEST; no deduplication
source_free: Original shared network only; remove V,u,b entirely; original trainer with SourceA0 constructor adapter and penalty0; not historical R0

validation: Original .005 threshold grid with MF1/EZF1/pooledBA/proximity.5/smallerTau ties; checkpoint patient MF1/EZF1/earlier epoch; each arm/fold independently selects on validation only
primary_unit: Equal-patient mean, each TEST patient once per arm; not mean of unequal-fold means

freeze: All 35 checkpoint/preprocessor/mask/threshold bindings before new TEST inference; all 35 predictions sealed before full-cohort y read
label_orientation: EZ0 NEZ1, sigmoid NEZ logit; EZ iff score < own frozen threshold; ascending probability rank, stable channel-string ties
